spec.scope: Heal effect, not a damage/stat buff — 6.28% of the SKILL USER'S (pascal's) final Max HP, recovered as HP to the target. HP-scaler rule: counts pascal's OWN live Max HP only (ally-granted Max HP would not feed it).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant heal on each activation; no duration. The trigger is a repeating counter, not one-shot: fires EVERY 10 rounds fired, cumulative across reloads (ammo 6 → each activation spans at least one reload).
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:10 — 'after firing 10 time(s)' counts ROUNDS the owner fires (RL hitsPerShot 1, so pulls = rounds). NOT interval{sec:10}, NOT lastBullet, NOT once-only. No FB gate stated → fires in and out of Full Burst at the same threshold.
spec.targetSet: 1 ally with the HIGHEST FINAL DEF. The target vocabulary has no DEF-ranked kind (only alliesTopAtk / alliesLowestAtk / alliesLowestHp / class / element / weapon) — this is a schema GAP requiring a documented deterministic stand-in. At scope lock a Defender-class ally (class static DEF is highest) is the faithful resolution; note 'final DEF' would formally want live-DEF ranking, but with no DEF buffs in the control fixture static class ranking is exact.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipping the line entirely as 'defensive heal, no damage relevance' (the classic drop), or encoding the trigger as interval{sec:10} (wall-clock instead of rounds-fired), or targeting self/all-allies instead of 1 DEF-ranked ally.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: There is no 'heal' event kind in cfg.onEvent, so assert through the tandem consumer already in the control fixture: crown (B2 slot) carries a 'when recovery takes effect' trigger. Run controlComp(pascal); collect crown's recovery-driven buffApply events. GREEN-faithful: their count equals floor(pascal's total shots/10) and their frame timestamps track pascal's fire+reload cadence (gaps stretch across her 171-frame reloads). RED-under-interval: events land every 600 frames regardless of reloads. RED-under-skip: zero such buffApply events, and totals(res) for crown's recovery-fed contribution drops when pascal's skill1 block is stripped via withPatchedOverride.
spec.inertness: Alone (no recovery-trigger teammate), the heal must move ZERO damage — pascal's own totals identical with skill1 stripped. It must NOT be encoded as any stat buff or damage effect.

spec.scope: 'Incoming healing ▲ 38.4%' — a heal-received amplifier on the targets. StatKey has no incoming-healing stat, and the engine's recovery trigger fires on heal RECEIPT regardless of magnitude, so the buff has no modeled consumer: it neither changes damage nor changes whether/when recovery triggers fire.
spec.durationSemantics: 10 sec wall-clock (durationSec 10) — genuine seconds here, no round-count wording.
spec.triggerIdentity: stageEnter{stage:1} — 'when entering Burst Stage 1' fires when ANYONE casts a Stage-1 burst (liter's B1 cast counts), NOT only pascal's own cast. This is the burstCast-vs-stageEnter twin of the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter trap: in any comp with a second Burst-I unit the two diverge every rotation.
spec.targetSet: alliesLowestHp count:3 — 'lowest remaining HP' is indeterminate in v1 (no HP pool); documented stand-in resolves to the leftmost 3 allies.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Forcing the magnitude into an existing stat (e.g. a generic heal/atk buff) to avoid 'dropping' it, or keying the trigger to burstCast (pascal-only) — both wrong; the faithful move is verbatim unmodeled text.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Inertness assertion: totals(res) for every unit is bit-identical with the skill2 block removed via withPatchedOverride, AND no buffApply event with an unexpected stat is emitted at Stage-1 entry. If the driver DID model it, the review must check the trigger fires on liter's B1 cast (stageEnter), not only pascal's.
spec.inertness: Must move zero damage for all five units; must not emit spurious buffApply events; must not alter recovery-trigger firing on crown.

spec.kitLine: Recovers 55.29% of user's final Max HP
spec.scope: Instant heal to 3 allies, 55.29% of PASCAL'S final Max HP (caster-scaled, own live Max HP only). No damage component; no FB/range/crit questions arise — but the heal is a tandem driver.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (stage 1) — this is pascal's OWN burst block, so it fires ONLY on rotations pascal herself casts, never on liter's B1 casts. Burst-cast effects land PRE-Full-Burst (before the FB window opens). With liter sharing Burst I in the control fixture, first-ready-in-window selection + pascal's 40s cd decide which rotations she actually casts — the test must pin this before asserting cadence.
spec.targetSet: alliesLowestHp count:3 — leftmost-3 stand-in (v1 has no HP pool). Whether crown's slot falls inside the leftmost 3 determines whether her recovery trigger fires off this heal; the test must fix the slot layout deliberately.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keying to fullBurstEnter or stageEnter{1} (fires on EVERY rotation's B1 cast including liter's — over-fires the tandem recovery procs by roughly the ratio of total rotations to pascal-cast rotations), or skipping the heal as defensive.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Collect burstCast events for pascal and crown's recovery-driven buffApply events. GREEN-faithful: a burst-sourced recovery proc on crown occurs exactly and only on frames where a burstCast event with pascal's slot fired (over and above the skill1-cadence procs). RED-under-stageEnter: burst-heal procs appear on every rotation including those where the burstCast event belongs to liter. RED-under-skip: no burst-coincident recovery procs at all.
spec.inertness: Pascal's own damage totals must not change from the heal itself; rotations pascal does NOT burst must show no burst-heal recovery proc.

loadBearingSet: skill1:hitCount-10 heal (6.28% caster MaxHP, tandem recovery driver)
burst:burstCast heal (55.29% caster MaxHP to 3 allies, tandem recovery driver)
notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to reconcile: (1) THE BIG ONE — both heals look offensively inert in isolation, and the taxonomy's tandem rule makes them load-bearing anyway: crown sits in the control fixture's fixed B2 slot with a 'when recovery takes effect' trigger, so pascal's heals are a live cross-unit damage channel; a driver who dispositioned the heals as skip/inert has under-modeled. (2) There is NO 'heal' event kind in cfg.onEvent — every assertion must be routed through the recovery-trigger consumer (crown's buffApply stream) or through withPatchedOverride A/Bs on totals; a test asserting on a nonexistent heal event vacuously passes. (3) skill1's target needs a DEF-ranked target kind the schema lacks — verify the driver documented a stand-in rather than silently targeting self/leftmost without noting it; at scope lock the Defender-class ally is the correct resolution. (4) burst is burstCast (pascal's own, pre-FB) while skill2 is stageEnter{1} (anyone's B1) — with liter also Burst I in controlComp these diverge every rotation pascal doesn't cast; a test that never pins WHICH B1 unit bursts cannot distinguish them. Pascal's 40s cd vs liter's shorter cd makes 'pascal never actually bursts in the fixture' a real vacuous-pass risk — the test should force or verify at least one pascal cast. (5) skill1's 'after firing 10 time(s)' must count rounds fired across reloads (ammo 6, 171-frame reload), not wall-clock and not per-magazine.
